Purina Connect | Purina Canada # Purina Connect ## From home, the office or the stable, connect with your Equine Nutrition Consultant. ## Contact Us. No matter where you are, Purina is right there with you! Purina Connect offers you access to one of our equine nutrition consultants from the comfort of your own home or at the stable. We can be reached on a toll-free number, through Facebook Messenger or by email. ### By Phone – 1 (888) 458-6914 Purina Connect’s toll free number allows you to reach us promptly for all your questions regarding our products and services. We can be reached at 1 (888) 458-6914. If you happen to call outside of the Purina Connect operating hours, you can leave us a voice mail and we will call you back as soon as possible! ### Facebook Messenger Simply slide into our Facebook Messenger, and our team of experts will be ready to guide you on your journey toward a healthier, happier, and well-nourished horse! ### E-mail – [email protected] You can also reach our team of experts by email @ [email protected]
